epics.title: Unblock stuck operations auditor subject
epics.jtbd: When operating the platform, I want stuck subjects to be resolved by overriding mechanical retirement, so that the operations auditor can resume processing valid requirements.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce blocked operations auditor tasks to 0%
requirements: R1: Move subject fd6672c6-02c4-455e-a4d9-91e4ae9d308c out of the stuck state using an atomically-guarded database update that bypasses the poka-yoke blocker (ea2d1954-4da4-4912-8565-dcd27a569279).

slices.title: Resolve stuck subject via atomic update
slices.jtbd: When implementing this patch for this epic, I want to execute an atomically-guarded update on subject fd6672c6-02c4-455e-a4d9-91e4ae9d308c, so that the operations auditor can resume processing without manual intervention.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a database record for subject fd6672c6-02c4-455e-a4d9-91e4ae9d308c stuck by task ea2d1954-4da4-4912-8565-dcd27a569279, When the atomic UPDATE patch is applied, Then the state transitions to a resolvable state.
Given the subject is updated, When the operations auditor reads the subject, Then it correctly processes it without failing on the previous iteration-admission poka-yoke.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Achieve 100% success rate on the subject patch migration
